{{Quote|Slice into the network and get what you need. I'll hold off security.|Scourge orders Sechel to get the files they came for while he will hold off security|<ref name="Revan" />}}
In [[3954 BBY]], a '''mission''' was undertaken by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] and [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]]' [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] [[Sechel]] to discover who purchased the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that had attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Gender/Legends|her]] during the [[Assassination attempts on Darth Nyriss|second attempt on her life]]. After arriving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hallion]], they infiltrated the [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing plant]] and Scourge had to fight several [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing patrol drone|patrol drones]] and one [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing assault droid|assault droid]] while Sechel [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into the factory's network. After copying the files, Sechel sliced into the power grid and shut the plant down. The power outage destabilized the plant's vats that used [[Trivium generator]] reactor cores. The pair escaped the plant shortly before the trivium generators exploded, destroying the plant.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I want Sechel to check out the plant. Once inside, he can slice into their computer network to find out who arranged the purchase. I hired those mercenaries you dispatched to get him past security. That task now falls to you.|Darth Nyriss orders Scourge to escort and protect Sechel during their mission|<ref name="Revan" />}}
In 3954 BBY, several assassination attempts were made on Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss' life, the most recent attempt involved a serving droid armed with a [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor beam]] that mistakenly killed her [[Darth Nyriss's chef|chef]], [[Memory wipe/Legends|wiping]] its own memory core immediately after. After the attempt, her advisor Sechel was able to slice into the droid's memory, discovering it was created at a privately-owned plant on the planet Hallion. She then hired [[Unidentified female mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|two]] [[Unidentified male mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|mercenaries]] to follow up this lead, but before they could assist, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] intervened, forcing Nyriss to ask for the Sith Lord Scourge's help. Shortly after Scourge's arrival on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], Nyriss sent Sechel to escort him to her [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|stronghold]] and ordered the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to kill Scourge. After a brief [[Skirmish outside of Darth Nyriss's stronghold|skirmish]], Scourge killed the male, and before the female could identify her employer, she was killed by Nyriss' security [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Murtog]] and five guards.<ref name="Revan" />

Nyriss later revealed to Scourge that she hired the mercenaries who attacked them as well as the reason she had Sechel order them to kill him. After this revelation, she ordered Scourge to protect her advisor during his mission on Hallion.<ref name="Revan" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|You know those big vats? They use trivium generators to melt the metal. Shutting down the power grid destabilized the reactor cores.''"<br />"''How long before the blow?''"<br />"''Not long enough to keep discussing it.|Sechel alerts Scourge of the plants imminent destruction|<ref name="Revan" />}}
After arriving on the Hallion, the pair studied the building and through his [[Night-vision goggles/Legends|night goggles]] Scourge noted a security fence that wasn't in Sechel's blueprints of the plant, as well as one [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing patrol drone|patrol drone]]. Scourge [[Force jump/Legends|leapt]] over the fence and proceeded to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber throw|severely damage]] the drone. After destroying the droid, he proceeded to cut the power to the fence and open the gate, allowing Sechel inside. The pair then infiltrated the manufacturing plant, crossing the main production floor which was lined with four enormous melting vats, making their way to records office. When the code Sechel provided failed to open the door to the office, Scourge used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to destroy the access panel.<ref name="Revan" />

His action set off the alarm system, alerting the plant's security force to the intrusion. Scourge ordered Sechel to slice into the mainframe and find the necessary files while he would face the plants security. Shortly after, two [[Sentry droid/Legends|patrol drones]] emerged. Scourge [[Force speed/Legends|charged]] the drones, rolled underneath them, and unleashed a series of vicious lightsaber cuts, ending the encounter. Upon dispatching the drones, another pair entered the room. Scourge threw his lightsaber to dispatch the first droid, and then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|slam]] the second against the floor, destroying it. Five more patrol drones and one [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing assault droid|assault droid]] entered the room, and the [[assault droid]] charged Scourge while firing, forcing the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to take cover behind a nearby conveyor belt.<ref name="Revan" />

He then climbed the nearest catwalk to avoid the assault droids range of fire. The patrol drones charged Scourge, who ran to the nearest melting vat. Two of the drones attempted to cut off Scourge's escape, only to be thrown into each other, dropping into one of the melting vats. The three remaining droids avoided the vats and cut off Scourge's escape, and he ran back toward the assault droid and proceeded to jump directly on top of the droid. He used his lightsaber to slice through the droids [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating, but before he could damage any of the internal circuitry, he was thrown clear of the machine.<ref name="Revan" />

After he regained his balance, he attacked the droid again from its blind side and finally managed to damage the droid, causing the droid to lash out and kick Scourge square in the chest, breaking one of his ribs. Scourge then crawled under the droid, using it as a shield to protect himself from the incoming fire of the surviving patrol drones, as he [[Shiak|stabbed]] the unarmored underside of the droid, finally finishing it off. Before he could savor his victory, another swarm of drones and two more assault droids entered the room. He readied himself for more combat just as Sechel cut the power to the plant. Scourge re-equipped his night goggles and [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] Sechel, asking about his status and why the power went out.<ref name="Revan" />

Sechel replied that he had copied the necessary files and that he had sliced into the power grid to shut the plant down. He then notified the Sith Lord that the power outage destabilized the Trivium generator reactor cores that the melting vats used. The pair escaped the plant shortly before the trivium generators exploded, destroying the plant.<ref name="Revan" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Sechel was able to use the information he acquired at UDM to locate their base in the mountains of Bosthirda. If they heard about the destruction of the UDM plant, they may be suspicious. We must strike, before they can move to a new location. My people are leaving for Bosthirda tonight; you will accompany them.''"<br />"''You're sending Sechel with me again?''"<br />"''They may have connections to other terrorist groups. Sechel will be able to slice their records and find out who they are working with. I'm also sending Murtog and his soldiers with you. Sechel will be your precision instrument; the soldiers will be your blunt tool.''"<br />"''The human filth will die, my lord. I will not fail.|Darth Nyriss orders Scourge to help Murtog and Sechel in the raid on the Bosthirda separatists compund|<ref name="Revan" />}}
A [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later, Nyriss revealed to Scourge that the droid that attacked her was purchased by [[Bosthirda separatists|separatists]] from the world of [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]]&mdash;who were trying to free their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] from the Emperor and the Dark Council&mdash;and sent Scourge, Sechel, and her security chief Murtog to [[Mission to Bosthirda (3954 BBY)|raid]] the [[Bosthirda separatist compound|separatists' compound]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
